query:
SELECT s.venue, COUNT(*) as payment_count, SUM(pr.amount) as total_amount
FROM paymentRecords pr
JOIN students s ON pr.studentId = s.id
WHERE pr.paymentPeriod = 'Q1' AND YEAR(pr.paymentDate) = 2026
GROUP BY s.venue
ORDER BY payment_count DESC;
